items.description: Apple's first foldable, tentatively dubbed the iPhone Ultra, is now finally picking up pace when it comes to the typical pre-production calibrations, bringing with it an onslaught of juicy tidbits that are able to pass through Apple's sprawling, albeit sieve-like, supply chains. items.title: Computex 2026 Day Zero Wrap-Up: Nvidia launches RTX Spark Superchip assault on laptop and desktop markets, Intel readies Xeon 6+

items.title: PS’s FlexStrike Fight Stick Arrives in August for Marvel Tokon Fighting Souls, New 27″ Monitor and Pulse Elevate Speakers Arrive Later
items.description: Back in June 2025, PlayStation announced 'Project Defiant,' a new wireless fight stick built for use with PlayStation consoles and PCs. items.description: Nvidia unveiled the RTX Spark superchip on May 31st ahead of its GTC Taipei event, putting a 20-core Arm-based Grace CPU and a Blackwell RTX GPU on a single package.
items.tldr: Nvidiaは、20コアのArmベースのGrace CPUとBlackwell RTX GPUを統合したRTX Sparkスーパーチップを発表し、QualcommのWindows on Arm契約の終了後に市場での機会を捉える準備を整えています。

items.title: MSI Pushes NVIDIA’s RTX Spark Into The Mainstream With A Developer Mini PC And A Tandem OLED Flip Laptop
items.description: Vendors have been quick to adopt the latest NVIDIA RTX Spark SoC in their devices, and MSI has deployed it in both mini PCs and laptops. MSI Power EdgeMesa N AI+ Mini PC and Prestige Flip AI+ Laptop With NVIDIA RTX Spark, Delivering a Powerful Arm+Blackwell Combo for Strong Compute and AI Performanc

items.title: Qualcomm Executive Is “Excited” For The RTX Spark’s Arrival And Wants To Welcome It To the New Family Of SoCs That’s “Growing Outside Of x86”
items.description: NVIDIA’s announcement of the RTX Spark has caught the attention of the entire computing industry, including Qualcomm’s, which now needs to find a new way to deal with its latest rival. Then again, the company’s Senior Vice President of Computing, Kedar Kondap, doesn’t appear to be fazed by the unvei
items.tldr: Qualcommの上級副社長Kedar Kondapは、NVIDIAのRTX Sparkの登場に興奮しており、x86以外の新しいSoCファミリーの成長を歓迎したいと述べている。

items.title: Qualcomm aims Snapdragon C laptop chip at the budget laptop segment, as manufacturers feel the DRAM squeeze — analysts warn sub $500 laptop market may disappear before 2028
items.description: Qualcomm announced the Snapdragon C Platform on May 28th, ahead of Computex 2026 in Taipei.
items.tldr: Qualcommは、2026年のComputexに先立ち、予算向けノートパソコン市場をターゲットにしたSnapdragon Cプラットフォームを発表したが、アナリストは500ドル未満のノートパソコン市場が2028年までに消失する可能性があると警告している。

items.title: Access Tom’s Hardware Premium’s Computex 2026 coverage for free —  sign up for an account to read insider reports from the show
items.description: For a limited time, you’ll be able to read all of our latest reports from Computex 2026 with a Tom’s Hardware account, no payment required.
items.tldr: Tom's Hardwareでは、Computex 2026の最新レポートを無料で読むためにアカウント登録が可能です。

items.description: Technically speaking, it's true, even if the XBOX Ally X is actually manufactured by ASUS. Okay, maybe Asha doesn't really have anything to do with it - having only picked up the mantle of CEO a few months ago - but it's still an interesting thought. ASUS Launches XBOX Ally X20 Bundle At ROG 20th An
items.tldr: XBOX Ally X20バンドルの発売は、新CEOアシャ・シャルマの下での初のハードウェアローンチを示しており、実際にはASUSによって製造されています。

items.title: Embark Studios Reportedly Testing Two PvE-Focused ARC Raiders Map Conditions in China, Seemingly Leaning Into PvE-Focused Players
items.description: If you've been playing ARC Raiders since it launched in October 2025, then you've seen evolve into a friendlier sort of extraction shooter. One where players have chosen to play a PvE game, only firing their weapons at robotic ARC enemies instead of other Raiders. Now, a new report from Insider-Gami
items.tldr: Embark StudiosがARC RaidersのPvEプレイヤー向けに、中国で2つのPvEフォーカスのマップ条件をテストしているとの報告があり、ゲームがより友好的な抽出シューターに進化している。

items.title: ASRock’s New N250M/D5 Strips A Desktop Down To One DIMM, One SSD, And Zero Fans For Silent Builds
items.description: The N250M/D5 is a fanless platform, featuring the entry-level Alder Lake N250 processor that comes in a quad core configuration. ASRock Launches N250M/D5 Motherboard With Pre-Installed and Passively Cooled Alder Lane N250 Processor Single-slot DIMM motherboards are pretty rare, but it doesn't matter
items.tldr: ASRockの新しいN250M/D5マザーボードは、ファンレス設計で、クアッドコアのAlder Lake N250プロセッサを搭載し、1つのDIMMスロットと1つのSSDをサポートする静音ビルド向けのプラットフォームです。

items.title: Dell Undercuts Apple’s MacBook Neo With a $599 XPS 13 That’s Lighter, Brighter, and Packs a Backlit Keyboard Apple Skipped
items.description: Dell is bringing the value back to PCs with its XPS 13 laptop that packs Intel's Core Series 3, a bigger display, & a lightweight design, starting at $599. Dell Pitches XPS 13 As The Perfect Laptop & MacBook Neo Competitor For Everyday Use, Delivers Up To 17 Hours Battery at $599 The Dell XP
items.tldr: Dellは、599ドルから始まるXPS 13ノートパソコンを発表し、AppleのMacBook Neoに対抗。XPS 13は軽量で明るいディスプレイを搭載し、バックライトキーボードも備えており、最大17時間のバッテリー寿命を提供します。

items.title: Asus' world-first OLED esports monitor can hit 540Hz at 1080p — ROG Strix OLED model among four fresh offerings

items.title: Star Wars Jedi 3 Will Reportedly Feature An Older Cal, As Announcement Inches Closer 3 Years After Development Began
items.description: It has been some time since the release of Star Wars Jedi: Survivor, but the series is not yet done, as publisher EA itself recently said that there are more stories coming with series protagonist Cal Kestis. According to a new rumor originating from reliable insider Tom Henderson, these stories wil
items.tldr: 「Star Wars Jedi 3」では、シリーズの主人公カル・ケスティスが年齢を重ねた姿で登場する可能性が高く、EAがさらなる物語の展開を示唆している。

items.title: Asus rolls out a ROG 20th anniversary chair and backpack, alongside commemorative components and peripherals — ROG Destrier Edition 20, ROG SLASH Hard-case Luggage Edition 20 are back in black (and gold)
items.description: Apart from hardware, Asus’s ROG 20th anniversary products include a Destreir Edition 20 gaming chair and gold-accented luggage and backpacks.

items.title: Seven hospitalized after toxic gas fire at SK hynix advanced memory plant — Cheongju 4th campus incident today led to all 3,600 staff being evacuated
items.description: Thousands of SK hynix employees fled their factory stations earlier today as a fire broke out in a room where fluorine gas was used.
items.tldr: SK hynixの先進メモリ工場でフッ素ガスを使用している部屋で火災が発生し、全3,600人のスタッフが避難、7人が入院しました。

items.title: Hackers Used Meta’s AI Support Bot to Seize Instagram Accounts
items.description: The Instagram accounts for the Obama White House and the Chief Master Sergeant of the U.S. Space Force were briefly defaced with pro-Iranian images and messages over the weekend, after instructions began circulating on Telegram showing how to trick Meta's "AI support assistant" bot into resetting ac
items.tldr: ハッカーがMetaのAIサポートボットを利用して、オバマホワイトハウスや米宇宙軍の最高軍曹のInstagramアカウントを一時的に改ざんし、親イランの画像やメッセージを表示させた。

items.title: WordPress malware campaign hides payloads in Steam profiles
items.description: Nearly 2,000 WordPress websites were infected with malware that relies on Steam Community profile comments to hide command-and-control (C2) data. [...]
items.tldr: 約2,000のWordPressウェブサイトが、Steam Communityのプロフィールコメントを利用してコマンド・アンド・コントロール（C2）データを隠すマルウェアに感染しました。

items.title: Vulnerability Disclosure in the Age of AI
items.description: New article: “Responsible Disclosure in the Age of AI: A Call for Urgent Action,” by Melissa Hathaway. Abstract: Artificial intelligence is fundamentally reshaping the balance between vulnerability discovery and remediation. Frontier AI models are now capable of autonomously identifying
items.tldr: AIは脆弱性の発見と修正のバランスを根本的に変えており、フロンティアAIモデルは自律的に脆弱性を特定できる能力を持つため、責任ある開示の重要性が高まっている。

items.title: Microsoft investigates Office Apps, Teams file access issues
items.description: Microsoft says an ongoing incident is preventing users of its Teams collaboration platform and Office for the web cloud-based productivity suite from opening files. [...]
items.tldr: Microsoftは、TeamsおよびOffice for the webのユーザーがファイルを開けない問題について調査を進めている。

items.title: Patch Now: Another Palo Alto Auth Bypass Bug Under Active Exploit
items.description: Exploiting the PAN-OS GlobalProtect VPN vulnerability requires certain conditions, but adversaries have done so in two attack waves that started in mid-May.
items.tldr: TL;DR: PAN-OSのGlobalProtect VPNにおける認証バイパスの脆弱性が悪用されており、5月中旬から2回の攻撃波が発生しているため、早急なパッチ適用が求められています。

items.title: Race Against Time: Why Faster Vulnerability Alerts Matter
items.description: Attackers are exploiting vulnerabilities faster than many organizations can identify and patch them. SecAlerts explains why faster vulnerability alerts can help reduce exposure and improve response times. [...]
items.tldr: TL;DR: 攻撃者は脆弱性を迅速に悪用しているため、迅速な脆弱性アラートが重要であり、これにより露出を減らし、対応時間を改善できるとSecAlertsが説明しています。

items.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: New Linux Flaw, PAN-OS Exploit, AI-Powered Attacks, OAuth Phishing and More
items.description: Monday hit like a cron job with anger issues. A busted auth path here, a repo-side faceplant there, some "patched-ish" thing already getting chewed on in the wild, and then the usual bonus round: poisoned dev tools, sketchy forum chatter, phishing kits pretending to be productivity, and AI lowering
items.tldr: 今週のサイバーセキュリティニュースでは、新たなLinuxの脆弱性やPAN-OSのエクスプロイト、AIを利用した攻撃、OAuthフィッシングなどが報告され、開発ツールの悪用やフィッシングキットの増加も懸念されています。

items.title: Critical Windows Netlogon RCE flaw now exploited in attacks
items.description: The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB), the country's national authority for cybersecurity, warned on Friday that threat actors are now exploiting a recently patched critical Windows Netlogon vulnerability in attacks. [...]
items.tldr: 最近修正されたWindows Netlogonの重大な脆弱性が攻撃者によって悪用されていると、ベルギーのサイバーセキュリティセンター（CCB）が警告しました。

items.title: Webinar tomorrow: From alert to resolution in network incident response
items.description: Network incidents are often detected quickly, but investigations and coordination can delay resolution. Join our webinar tomorrow to learn how automation and AI-assisted workflows can help IT teams accelerate incident response. [...]
items.tldr: 明日のウェビナーでは、ネットワークインシデントの迅速な検出から解決までのプロセスを、オートメーションとAI支援のワークフローを活用してITチームがどのように加速できるかを学びます。

items.title: China-Aligned Groups Ramp Up Attacks: Dragon Weave Hits Czech Republic & Taiwan
items.description: A new cyber espionage campaign codenamed Operation Dragon Weave has been observed targeting officials and citizens in the Czech Republic and Taiwan to deliver an AdaptixC2 agent. According to Seqrite Labs, targets of the campaign include government, research, academic, technology, and financial serv
items.tldr: 中国に関連するグループが「Operation Dragon Weave」と呼ばれるサイバー諜報キャンペーンを展開し、チェコ共和国と台湾の政府関係者や市民を狙ってAdaptixC2エージェントを配布している。

items.title: Microsoft fixes outage affecting MFA setup, MySignIn service
items.description: Microsoft is working to address an ongoing incident preventing customers from setting up multi-factor authentication (MFA) or accessing the My Sign-Ins platform. [...]
items.tldr: Microsoftは、マルチファクター認証（MFA）の設定やMy Sign-Insプラットフォームへのアクセスを妨げている障害を修正中です。

items.title: The Security Growth Platform: Why MSPs Are Moving Beyond vCISO Tools
items.description: Three years ago, the practical question for an MSP building a cybersecurity practice was which "vCISO platform" to buy. The term was good shorthand for the work at the time: assessments, advisory, reporting, maybe a compliance module bolted on the side. The work has since outgrown the descriptor. A
items.tldr: MSPはサイバーセキュリティプラクティスを構築する際、vCISOツールを超えたセキュリティ成長プラットフォームに移行しており、従来の評価や助言、報告に加えて、より包括的なサービスが求められるようになっている。

items.title: Microsoft fixes KB5089549 Windows security update install issues
items.description: Microsoft has resolved a known issue causing installation failures and 0x800f0922 errors when deploying the May 2026 Windows 11 security update (KB5089549). [...]
items.tldr: Microsoftは、2026年5月のWindows 11セキュリティ更新プログラム（KB5089549）のインストール失敗や0x800f0922エラーを引き起こす既知の問題を修正しました。

items.title: OpenAI Codex Authentication Tokens Stolen in codexui-android npm Supply Chain Attack
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a new malicious supply chain campaign that's targeting developers using OpenAI Codex through a legitimate-looking remote web UI. The tool, named codexui-android, is advertised on GitHub and npm as a remote web UI for OpenAI Codex, attracting over 2
items.tldr: OpenAI Codexを利用する開発者を狙った新たなサプライチェーン攻撃が発覚し、codexui-androidというツールを通じて認証トークンが盗まれた。

items.title: Critical WP Maps Pro Flaw Actively Exploited to Create Admin Accounts
items.description: Threat actors are attempting to actively exploit a critical security flaw impacting WP Maps Pro, a WordPress plugin that has had over 15,000 sales on the Envato Market, to create malicious administrator accounts on susceptible sites. WP Maps Pro allows site owners to embed customizable Google Maps a
items.tldr: WP Maps Proの重大なセキュリティ脆弱性が悪用され、攻撃者が脆弱なサイトに悪意のある管理者アカウントを作成しようとしています。

items.title: WP Maps Pro bug exploited to create admin accounts on WordPress sites
items.description: Hackers are targeting WordPress websites running a vulnerable version of the WP Maps Pro plugin, which allows creating rogue administrator accounts without authentication. [...]
items.tldr: WP Maps Proプラグインの脆弱性を悪用し、ハッカーがWordPressサイトに不正な管理者アカウントを作成する攻撃が行われている。

items.title: Dutch Authorities Dismantle Botnet Linked to 17 Million Infected Devices
items.description: Dutch authorities have announced the takedown of a botnet that enslaved millions of infected devices, including computers, tablets, smartphones, and IoT devices, to carry out malicious attacks. The bot network, per the Dutch Politie and the National Cyber Security Center (NCSC), consisted of at leas
items.tldr: オランダ当局は、1700万台以上の感染デバイスを支配していたボットネットを解体したと発表した。このボットネットは、コンピュータ、タブレット、スマートフォン、IoTデバイスを利用して悪意のある攻撃を実行していた。

items.title: Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN auth bypass flaw now exploited in attacks
items.description: Palo Alto Networks is warning that hackers are now exploiting a PAN-OS GlobalProtect authentication bypass flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-0257, in attacks attempting to breach corporate networks. [...]

items.title: New CIFSwitch Linux flaw gives root on multiple distributions
items.description: A newly discovered local privilege escalation vulnerability dubbed 'CIFSwitch' in the Linux kernel could allow attackers to forge CIFS authentication key descriptions, abuse the kernel's key request mechanism, and gain root privileges. [...]
items.tldr: 新たに発見されたLinuxカーネルのローカル特権昇格脆弱性「CIFSwitch」により、攻撃者がCIFS認証キーの説明を偽造し、カーネルのキー要求メカニズムを悪用して複数のディストリビューションでroot権限を取得できる可能性があります。

items.title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-0257) Under Active Exploitation
items.description: Palo Alto Networks has warned that a recently disclosed medium-severity security flaw impacting PAN-OS and Prisma Access has come under active exploitation in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-0257 (CVSS score: 7.8), refers to a case of authentication bypass that could be exploited by
items.tldr: Palo Alto Networksは、PAN-OSとPrisma Accessに影響を与える中程度の深刻度の脆弱性CVE-2026-0257が実際に悪用されていると警告しています。この脆弱性は認証バイパスに関連しており、CVSSスコアは7.8です。
